subcategory_text: Attribute references are substituted for attribute values.
implementation_examples: Substitute attribute references for attribute values (e.g., tokens for identifiers, hash references for sensitive attributes) so that the raw attribute is not exposed in downstream processing
Document the substitution mapping, its inverse procedure, and the controls on the inverse procedure
Audit substitution completeness across data flows
assessment_objectives: Determine whether attribute references substitute for attribute values
Determine whether the substitution mapping is documented and reversible only under documented controls
Determine whether substitution completeness is audited
Determine whether the substitution pattern supports data integrity
